name: sense
description: Carry one private, user-controlled work profile across AI tools.

interface.shortDescription: Carry your work profile across AI tools
interface.longDescription: Sense keeps collaboration preferences and durable lessons in one private profile that the user can review, revise, or delete. AI tools use the same profile across different work, while project facts stay with their projects and source-specific context stays in Corpus. The profile remains on this Mac across plugin updates.
defaultPrompt: Show me the work profile you use when collaborating with me.
Use Sense to work with me on this task.
What has Sense learned from our work?
